product.title: From Paris: Versailles Bike Tour w/ Palace, Gardens, & Picnic

description.text: In Paris, the gardens of Versailles span an impressive 1,976 acres. Rather than exploring the sprawling grounds on foot, pedal your way around with an informative guide on this full-day Versailles bike tour from Paris. Stops include Place Du Marche Notre Dame, Grand Canal, The Grand Trianon, Le Petit Trianon, Queen’s Hamlet, Palace of Versailles. Discover garden trails and tree-lined paths behind the palace, and reach parts of the grounds that visitors on foot do not frequent, including Marie Antoinette's country-style hamlet, the Petit Trianon, and the Grand Trianon. Ideal for visitors basing in Paris who want a guided city experience without coordinating Metro routes, attraction tickets, or landmark timing on their own. Routes stay oriented to Place Du Marche Notre Dame, Grand Canal, The Grand Trianon, Le Petit Trianon that define this Paris sightseeing experience, with a guide handling Metro connections, ticket windows, and neighborhood pacing so the day stays focused on the city rather than logistics.
